capabilities: List outlines of the active note plus its outgoing-link and backlink files in a File View
List outlines of all files in a folder in a refreshable Folder View
Show headings, links, tags and list items with per-element visibility toggles
Preview note content inline or in tooltips
Pin, favorite and revisit views, and pin files or tag-matched files to the top of the list
extras: The README strongly recommends installing the Dataview plugin to speed up backlink retrieval, and documents read/process limits to control performance on large vaults. The author accepts donations via Buy Me a Coffee. A Japanese version of the documentation is included in the README.
intentEvidence: this is an adaptation of that plugin for regular files
motivation: The author had previously made the Daily Note Outline plugin for daily notes and adapted it to work with regular files.
problem: Obsidian's Outline view only shows the structure of the single active note, so there is no way to see the outlines of several related notes or a whole folder side by side.
